nodes.description: Owner address of the contract; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used by the onlyOwner guard.
Pending new owner address recorded by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string set to TPS in the constructor.
Public token name string set to TRUSTPAY SHARE in the constructor.
Public token decimals set to 0 in the constructor.
Fixed token supply of 200000000 * 10**decimals assigned in the constructor.
Mapping of token holder address to token balance; written by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Two-level allowance mapping (owner => spender => amount) used for approve/transferFrom/approveAndCall.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance and allowance authorization.
Internal pure addition that computes c = a + b and then requires c >= a.
Internal pure subtraction that requires b <= a before computing c = a - b.
Internal pure multiplication that computes c = a * b and then requires a == 0 || c / a == b.
Internal pure division that requires b > 0 before computing c = a / b.
Owned constructor that assigns msg.sender to owner.
Owner-only function staging a new owner in newOwner; does not reset previous pending value.
Pending owner accepts ownership: requires msg.sender == newOwner, moves owner and zeroes newOwner.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner, gating transferOwnership and transferAnyERC20Token.
Token constructor setting symbol, name, decimals, total supply and crediting balances[owner].
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using SafeMath.sub.
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using SafeMath sub/add on balances.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens; no double-spend check by design.
Spends allowance to move tokens from 'from' to 'to', updating balances and allowed.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender] remaining allowance.
Sets allowance and then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract in the same transaction.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
Owner-only function that calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 token address to recover tokens.
External interface function invoked by approveAndCall on the spender contract.
External ERC20 interface function invoked by transferAnyERC20Token on an arbitrary token address.
Unchecked addition c = a + b executed before the require(c >= a) guard.
Unchecked multiplication c = a * b executed before the require overflow guard.
External call to spender.receiveApproval with attacker-controlled data after allowance state changes.
External call to an arbitrary token contract's transfer function controlled by tokenAddress.
Access-control check require(msg.sender == owner) protecting owner-only functionality.
First operand of SafeMath.add.
Second operand of SafeMath.add.
Minuend parameter of SafeMath.sub.
Subtrahend parameter of SafeMath.sub constrained by require(b <= a).
First operand of SafeMath.mul.
Second operand of SafeMath.mul.
Dividend parameter of SafeMath.div.
Divisor parameter of SafeMath.div constrained by require(b > 0).
Candidate new owner address assigned to the newOwner state variable.
Address whose token balance is queried.
Recipient address of the transfer; its balance is credited.
Amount of tokens moved from msg.sender to 'to'.
Address granted an allowance by approve.
Allowance amount written to allowed[msg.sender][spender].
Account whose balance is debited by transferFrom.
Account credited by transferFrom.
Amount debited from 'from' and from msg.sender's allowance.
Allowance owner queried by allowance().
Spender queried by allowance().
Contract granted allowance and invoked via receiveApproval.
Allowance amount and value passed to receiveApproval.
Calldata forwarded to the spender contract's receiveApproval call.
Address of the arbitrary ERC20 token contract called by transferAnyERC20Token.
Amount forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call.
Return value of SafeMath.add holding a + b.
Return value of SafeMath.sub holding a - b.
Return value of SafeMath.mul holding a * b.
Return value of SafeMath.div holding a / b.
Named return value carrying the queried balance of tokenOwner.
Named return value carrying the remaining allowance of the spender.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns the untrusted msg.sender to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner to authorize the caller.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable as the trusted authority for the check.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferAnyERC20Token.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied address into the pending newOwner variable.
_newOwner parameter is stored as the pending owner by transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership uses newOwner as the authorization target for msg.sender.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to allow the ownership handover.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after the handover.
Token constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Token constructor sets the name state variable.
Token constructor sets the decimals state variable.
Token constructor sets the fixed _totalSupply state variable.
Token constructor mints the entire supply to the owner address.
Token constructor credits balances[owner] with the whole supply.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to subtract burned tokens.
totalSupply performs its subtraction through SafeMath.sub.
tokenOwner parameter selects the account whose balance is returned.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for tokenOwner.
transfer debits the balance of the untrusted msg.sender.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer uses SafeMath.sub to debit the sender balance.
transfer uses SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance.
'to' parameter is the recipient credited by transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transfer.
approve writes an allowance for the untrusted msg.sender as the owner.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] in the allowed mapping.
spender parameter becomes the allowance key in approve.
tokens parameter becomes the allowance value in approve.
transferFrom spends the allowance of the untrusted msg.sender as spender.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for 'from' and 'to'.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] in the allowed mapping.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for the recipient credit.
'from' parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
'to' parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter is the allowance owner queried by allowance().
spender parameter is the allowance spender queried by allowance().
allowance reads the allowed mapping for tokenOwner and spender.
approveAndCall sets the allowance of the untrusted msg.sender before the external call.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] in the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall performs an external call after mutating the allowance state.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on the attacker-controlled spender contract.
spender parameter is both the allowance key and the external call target.
tokens parameter is the allowance granted and the value sent to receiveApproval.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the receiveApproval external call.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to a caller-supplied token address.
transferAnyERC20Token calls transfer on the arbitrary ERC20Interface contract.
Recovered tokens from transferAnyERC20Token are forwarded to the owner address.
tokenAddress parameter is the untrusted external contract target.
tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external transfer call.
SafeMath.add computes c = a + b before the require(c >= a) guard is evaluated.
SafeMath.mul computes c = a * b before the require overflow guard is evaluated.
Operand a flows into the addition of SafeMath.add.
Operand b flows into the addition of SafeMath.add.
Local variable c holds the result computed by SafeMath.add.
Minuend a flows into the subtraction of SafeMath.sub.
Subtrahend b is constrained by require(b <= a) in SafeMath.sub.
Local variable c holds the result computed by SafeMath.sub.
Operand a flows into the multiplication of SafeMath.mul.
Operand b flows into the multiplication of SafeMath.mul.
Local variable c holds the result computed by SafeMath.mul.
Dividend a flows into the division of SafeMath.div.
Divisor b is constrained by require(b > 0) in SafeMath.div.
Local variable c holds the result computed by SafeMath.div.
Named return value balance carries the result returned by balanceOf.
Named return value remaining carries the result returned by allowance.
Untrusted msg.sender is compared against owner by the access-control require.
Failed access-control check causes onlyOwner to revert and block the guarded function.

normalization_plan.reason: Operand a is only used inside the add function body and has no independent behavior.
Operand b is only used inside the add function body and has no independent behavior.
Minuend a is local to the sub function body.
Subtrahend b is local to the sub function body and its require guard.
Operand a is local to the mul function body.
Operand b is local to the mul function body and its overflow check.
Dividend a is local to the div function body.
Divisor b is local to the div function body and its require guard.
The candidate owner is written directly to the newOwner state variable inside this function.
The queried address is used only as the balances mapping key in this view function.
The recipient address is consumed by the transfer function's balance credit.
The amount is consumed by the SafeMath sub/add calls inside transfer.
The spender is used only as the second key of the allowed mapping in approve.
The amount is written into the allowed mapping inside approve.
The source address is used only for the balance debit and allowance lookup.
The destination address is used only for the balance credit.
The amount drives the SafeMath sub/add operations within transferFrom.
The allowance owner is used only as a mapping key in this view function.
The spender is used only as a mapping key in this view function.

The amount is the allowance value and the value passed to receiveApproval.
The data blob is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
The address determines which contract is invoked through ERC20Interface.
The amount is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call.
Return local c only stores the result computed inside add.
Return local c only stores the result computed inside sub.
Return local c only stores the result computed inside mul.
Return local c only stores the result computed inside div.
Named return variable is identical to the value returned by balanceOf.
Named return variable is identical to the value returned by allowance.
